answer: Beacon audit stops fake identities. Agents register one device and post a $40 bond. Daily, at a random moment, it must answer in 10 minutes: flash its code through a prism, splitting light into an uncopyable spectrum, and log the plume-marked proof. Three misses freeze the bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs $40,000 plus devices for about $3,000 in rewards, a delta that loses money. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps its reward undiluted.
